title: First coordinate restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional cube, and fix $b\in\{\pm1\}$. The restriction of $f$ to the slice whose first coordinate is $b$ is the function on the $n$-dimensional cube given by $x\mapsto f(b,x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional cube
